query: Rice production trends in Senegal over the last 5 years, with production volumes in tonnes
synthesis:
## Findings

A complete five-year, year-by-year series of Senegal’s rice production volumes could not be extracted from the available sources. The Our World in Data page identifies **2020–2024** as the latest five available years in its FAO-based dataset, but the scraped page does not display Senegal’s individual country-year values. [Rice production | Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/rice-production) The FAOSTAT landing page likewise describes the relevant dataset but does not provide Senegal-specific observations in the supplied extract. [FAOSTAT](https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/)

The available production figures are as follows:

| Marketing year or period | Production volume | Measurement and status |
|---|---:|---|
| MY 2023/24 | **1,034,000 tonnes**; official Senegal figure **1,037,000 tonnes** | Milled rice; USDA estimate and official estimate respectively [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual (April 21, 2025)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008) |
| MY 2024/25 | **600,000 tonnes** | Milled rice; April 2025 USDA estimate [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual (April 21, 2025)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008) |
| MY 2025/26 | **645,000 tonnes** | Milled rice; April 2025 forecast [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual (April 21, 2025)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008) |
| MY 2024/25 | **643,000 tonnes** | Milled rice; April 2026 report figure [Grain and Feed Annual – Senegal (April 21, 2026)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain+and+Feed+Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2026-0003.pdf) |
| MY 2025/26 | **646,000 tonnes** | Milled rice; Government of Senegal estimate [Grain and Feed Annual – Senegal (April 21, 2026)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain+and+Feed+Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2026-0003.pdf) |
| MY 2026/27 | **670,000 tonnes** | Milled rice; forecast [Grain and Feed Annual – Senegal (April 21, 2026)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain+and+Feed+Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2026-0003.pdf) |

The April 2025 USDA report describes a sharp fall from **1.034 million tonnes in MY 2023/24** to **600,000 tonnes in MY 2024/25**, followed by a forecast recovery to **645,000 tonnes in MY 2025/26**. It cautions that the fall is substantially a **statistical break**, because Senegal changed its production methodology and statistical reference base from MY 2024/25; therefore, the apparent decline should not be treated as a purely physical collapse in output. [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual (April 21, 2025)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008)

The later April 2026 USDA report gives a revised or alternative series: **643,000 tonnes in MY 2024/25**, **646,000 tonnes in MY 2025/26**, and **670,000 tonnes forecast for MY 2026/27**. On that series, milled-rice production rises by **27,000 tonnes**, or approximately **4.2%**, between MY 2024/25 and MY 2026/27. The two USDA reports therefore contain different estimates for overlapping years—**600,000 versus 643,000 tonnes for MY 2024/25**, and **645,000 versus 646,000 tonnes for MY 2025/26**—so those figures should not be combined into one uninterrupted trend. [Grain and Feed Annual – Senegal (April 21, 2026)](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain+and+Feed+Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2026-0003.pdf)

A separate source reports national **paddy** production of **more than 1.5 million tonnes in 2023**, but this is a different product basis from the USDA milled-rice series. It also reports **420,000 tonnes** of paddy from the Senegal River Valley during the **2025 hot off-season**, which is a regional seasonal figure rather than national annual production. These figures should not be directly compared with the national annual milled-rice totals. [Accelerating the Transition to Sustainable and Inclusive Rice Farming in Senegal](https://www.rikolto.org/projects/accelerating-the-transition-to-sustainable-and-inclusive-rice-farming-in-senegal)

## Overall assessment

The sources indicate that Senegal’s rice production increased substantially over the longer period from **551,000 tonnes in 2014** to **more than 1.5 million tonnes in 2023** on the paddy measure, while the more recent USDA milled-rice estimates show lower volumes and a modest recovery after the MY 2024/25 statistical break. [Accelerating the Transition to Sustainable and Inclusive Rice Farming in Senegal](https://www.rikolto.org/projects/accelerating-the-transition-to-sustainable-and-inclusive-rice-farming-in-senegal) However, the available sources did not contain comparable production volumes for every year of the requested five-year period. They also did not establish a single consistent conversion between paddy, rough rice, and milled rice. Consequently, a reliable five-year trend in tonnes cannot be calculated from these extracts alone.
